provenance.note: The course runs at 10, 50 and 25 m or yd, the record holds the longest distance. PP 2 may also be shot with optical sights as PP 2 Optical Sight, scored separately (C.6B.7, Teil C, PDF p. 29). A post may support the shooter but never the firearm. Sighters are shot on the 50 m station only. Optical sights are allowed in a separately scored class (C.6B.7).
